mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines in the prior month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.8% in the most recent month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market that contracts consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In industrial contraction regimes (INDPRO < 108.0), declining manufacturing output signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and earnings headwinds, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 108.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer income and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 255.0), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
